assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: the sixth gameplay concept image for a Korean-language game-design article, fictional RPG "Guests of Namgul".
Primary request: Create a wide 16:9 opaque, crisp 2D pixel-art actual top-down RPG gameplay screenshot mockup, rich readable indie game pixel art. This is a playable investigation scene with a clear bottom evidence journal, not a poster or illustrated cover.
Scene/backdrop: warmly glowing underground Korean village inside a large rock cavern. Small traditional Korean tiled roofs, ochre soil paths, hanging lanterns, turquoise shadows and warm cream lights. At upper left a golden rice spring emerges physically from a rock fissure, grains spilling into a shallow bowl and a short trail of rice blowing toward another crack. At upper right a small soil-fish pond. Ground details remain readable at game zoom.
Subject: in the central investigation area, a surface visitor protagonist wearing Korean hanbok is faint/translucent to local underground villagers; the villagers cannot clearly see visitors. The protagonist's solid tangible colorful paper pinwheel gift is clearly visible and catches the breeze beside a rice trail. A friendly underground child and a solid local guide stand by a lantern, another resolver companion observes the fissure. The paper pinwheel, rice, and footprints are visible environmental clues. The mood is friendly mystery and cross-cultural understanding.
Gameplay interface: modest top-left three character portrait party HUD; top-right small task compass or journal pictogram. Include an interact prompt near the pinwheel and a compact dialogue bubble from the child. The bottom quarter is a beautifully legible open detective journal UI: exactly three large illustrated evidence icons (rice grains, paper pinwheel, footprints) connected by thin clue lines to two witness portrait slots and a central proposed peaceful bridge/handshake icon. Highlight the selected pinwheel evidence with a warm yellow border and a tiny cursor. Text must be sparse, short English labels only, such as INVESTIGATE, EVIDENCE, WITNESS, AGREE, or pictograms, no dense sentences.
Style/medium: carefully clustered pixels, visible square pixels, clean limited palette, sharp sprite silhouettes and crisp game UI, genuinely 2D top-down tiled pixel-art world. No painterly digital illustration, no photorealistic lighting, no 3D.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9, target 1536x864; full gameplay screen with no outer margin or device mockup. Gameplay environment occupies upper three quarters, evidence journal lower quarter. Entire HUD and icon panels inside safe frame.
Color palette: teal, ochre, warm cream, lantern gold, slight vermilion pinwheel accent.
Constraints: opaque background; new fictional world art, not a historical document; emphasize interactive investigation and dialogue, no combat cards, no turn-battle layout, no branding, no logos, no watermark, no title poster. The surface visitor must appear faint; local villagers and tangible pinwheel remain solid.
visual_observations: A warmly lit underground Korean village is shown with tiled roofs, a rice spring emerging from rock at upper left, and a fish pond at upper right.
The central surface visitor is visibly translucent; the pinwheel, local child, and local guide remain solid. A separate companion observes the rice spring.
The lower journal has three distinct rice, pinwheel, and footprints evidence tiles, two witness portraits, connecting lines, and a handshake agreement icon.
The selected pinwheel tile has a yellow border and cursor; an INVESTIGATE interaction prompt and simple character dialogue bubbles are visible.
The camera is an elevated RPG view rather than a strictly orthographic production tilemap. The agreement icon is at the right end of the journal rather than its center.
Pixel clusters and sprite outlines are visible; detailed lighting and the large journal are concept-art treatment, not a finalized production HUD.
